title: In the bustling world we live in, it's rare to come across someone who shares our deepest passions and beliefs. But when that serendipitous encounter does happen, time seems to fly, leaving us longing for more. Such was the case when I met my dear friend and fellow worker for Christ Jesus, Pastor Junjy Singco.
paragraphs: In the bustling world we live in, it's rare to come across someone who shares our deepest passions and beliefs. But when that serendipitous encounter does happen, time seems to fly, leaving us longing for more. Such was the case when I met my dear friend and fellow worker for Christ Jesus, Pastor Junjy Singco.

From the moment we began talking, it was evident that we were kindred spirits, united by our unwavering faith and a burning desire to make a difference in the world. Our discussion revolved around a profound and thought-provoking passage from Deuteronomy 8:18, which resonated deeply within both our hearts.

As we delved into the meaning of those sacred words, a powerful connection was forged. We explored the concept of God's provision and the responsibility we have as stewards of the blessings bestowed upon us. It became clear that our shared passion for helping others and utilizing our God-given talents aligned perfectly with the teachings of this ancient scripture.

Time flew by as we exchanged ideas, anecdotes, and personal experiences that further affirmed our convictions. The world around us seemed to fade away, as if we were enveloped in a realm of spiritual communion and enlightenment. It was a meeting of minds and souls, an encounter that left an indelible mark on both our lives.

My gratitude overflowed as we bid farewell, for this meeting was not merely a chance encounter but a divine appointment. I expressed my sincerest gratitude to Pastor Junjy Singco, knowing that our discussions and shared ventures were just the beginning of a beautiful journey together. The prospect of future conversations filled my heart with joy and anticipation, for I knew that through our continued partnership, we would bring about even greater impact in the lives of those we serve.

So, as time continues its swift dance, I am thankful for the moments we shared, the wisdom we exchanged, and the friendship we cultivated. The fire within me burns brighter, knowing that I have a companion in this great mission we've embraced. With Pastor Junjy Singco by my side, I am inspired to reach new heights and touch more lives with the transformative power of faith, love, and God's Word.

Together, we embark on a journey filled with hope, purpose, and unwavering determination. As time flies, our discussions will only grow deeper, our ventures more impactful. And as we stand united, we will continue to spread the light of God's love, illuminating the world with our shared passion for Christ Jesus.
Thank you, my friend, and let our future endeavors be filled with abundant blessings and divine guidance.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: As a reservist officer in army, my favorite getup is a black tshirt, a cargo pants, a rifle and a side arm pistol.... now as i became a soldier for an army of God, nothing change but instead of rifle, it became a laptop and instead of a sidearm pistol, it became a phone with a bible installed on it.... the mission is still the same, go and defend for adversaries and equip others to fortify. Now, as we have been doing bible study and cellgroup here at weegols Garden, more became ready and been changed their lives toward God and willing to go for discipleship.
